profile.name: Mihir Patel
profile.heroDescription: I build software, train models, and tinker with AI systems. Currently exploring the space between solid engineering and intelligent products.

about.heading: Curious by default, builder by habit.
paragraphs: I'm Mihir — a recent graduate from Ahmedabad, India. I love sitting at the intersection of software, machine learning and AI, where ideas turn into working systems you can poke at and improve.

focus.title: Software Engineering
focus.desc: Full-stack web apps with TypeScript, React and Python backends.

focus.title: ML Engineering
focus.desc: Training, evaluating and shipping models with PyTorch and scikit-learn.

focus.title: AI Engineering
focus.desc: LLM apps, RAG pipelines and agents using LangChain and open models.

projects.title: SentimentScope
projects.desc: Fine-tuned a transformer model on multilingual product reviews to surface nuanced sentiment shifts in real time.

projects.title: AskMyDocs
projects.desc: RAG-powered assistant that lets users chat with their PDFs using local embeddings and an open-source LLM.

projects.title: VisionSort
projects.desc: Computer vision pipeline that classifies and sorts recyclable waste from a webcam feed with 94% accuracy.

contact.heading: Let's build something.
contact.description: I'm actively looking for my first role and open to collaborations on interesting software, ML or AI projects. The fastest way to reach me is email — I reply to everything.
